Synopsis:
BofA's co-head of investment banking Mike Joo (20-year veteran) is departing for an external opportunity. Despite several senior-level exits, BofA is actively expanding its GCIB team with 40+ new MDs in 2026, including hires from Goldman Sachs and Centerview. Faiz Ahmad and Karim Assef will co-lead global IB going forward. The backdrop is a record M&A environment driven by mega-deals in H1 2026, with BofA beating Q2 profit estimates on strong trading and IB revenues.
